answer: Randomized guarantor circles keep clone fleets self-immolating. When duplicate identities are confirmed, the ledger triggers a chain audit: each implicated name sits in a five-member circle drawn by lottery each epoch, and every member's 10,000 POA guarantee burns, so one proven clone torches 50,000 POA in shared collateral. A plume-sensor vendor, a delta logistics agent, and a wharf broker all vet would-be circle partners hard, since one fake neighbor burns the whole group.
